title: The checks-shoot job has room for the waiting-page tests, so batch 70 is not cancelled at its cap
why: Coordinator 16:15 CST Nov 9: on batch 70 (#2470, head f2d25d149) the checks-shoot job was cancelled at its 10 min cap (.github/workflows/checks.yml) while still passing, after the batch added waiting-page tests (#2347, #2383, #2423, #2429, #2466). The same job took 8 min on 624dcc188 and 7 min on 8bc28980b.
note: Fix: split the waiting-page suite into its own job, or raise the cap from measured runs, per decision ci-job-caps. Done check: the shoot jobs pass on a tree with batch 70's page tests, and each cap cites its measured runs. Related: ci-guard-headroom (lane session_013NEJKypwFEtaJwfYrMpZ5T). Lane session_013NEJL2Xf2CDoR4VGP4EE6P started 16:16 CST Nov 9 (coordinator). Scope widened (coordinator 16:27 CST Nov 9): three caps, checks-shoot, checks-merge-install's checkout-detection step, and shell-macos's; cause of the last two: #2458's install changes skipped those jobs on its own run (step install-change-runs-install-jobs).
